name: Permanent Residence -- Economic Investment

requirements.blocker_text: Requires a minimum US$1.0 million investment in Bahamian real estate or Central Bank Zero Coupon Bonds.
The qualifying investment must be held for a minimum of 10 years.
requirements.fix_path: Maintain the investment for at least 10 years.

evidence_required.document: Proof of qualifying investment (real estate deed or Central Bank Zero Coupon Bond certificate)

sources.title: Bahamas Immigration Department -- Permanent Residence: Economic Investment category, minimum US$1.0 million in real estate or Central Bank Zero Coupon Bonds, held 10+ years; explicitly no accelerated/fast-track investor tiers (e.g. $500k/$750k) mentioned on this official page

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of the Bahamas' initial build. IMPORTANT: several tier-3/4 sources online reference lower fast-track thresholds (commonly cited as $500,000, or $750,000 for expedited processing) for real-estate-based permanent residency in the Bahamas -- these were NOT found on the official immigration.gov.bs page itself, which states only the $1.0 million Economic Investment category with no accelerated tier. This route is built strictly on the confirmed tier-1 figure; the lower/expedited thresholds some private sources cite are not modelled here and may reflect either outdated information, a different (non-PR) fast-track process, or policy not yet reflected on the official page -- flagged as a gap rather than guessed.
